body:
Recreative Reborn is a modpack made by me and a friend. This pack is centered around the create mod. It features a handfully crafted questbook. **IMPORTANT!!!** Please download FTB Quests 2101.1.24, FTB Teams 2101.1.10 and FTB Library 2101.1.31 yourself, because I could not include them due to copyright reasons. This modpack does in fact feature unused configs and API/Lib mods, I will do my best to remove them in later updates, as well as I'll continue to add fun content. Thank you for playing :)\
Additional Info:\
Compact Machines don't show in JEI as I used a side-mod to add a way to craft those machines because I couldn't figure out how to make recipes for the built-in machines with KubeJS. To make the tiny one, place a redstone block in the middle of the grid, 4 iron above, below, to the left and right of it, and machine walls in the corners. From that point, you can press U (or whatever keybind you have) while hovering your cursor over it to see how to make the next machine, or press R and bookmark the recipe to have it visible on the left side of JEI. Also, if you see 8 errors in chat, it's just garnished being weird. You can safely ignore them :) Apparently KubeJS create crashes the game in some cases, but don't worry, it's entirely optional in 1.0.5! You can just remove it if it causes problems
